Hamon (1963) PET, in the form given by Lu et al. (2005)

Source: R/wbm_pet.R
pet_hamon.Rd

FIX: the NPS WBM version used (T + 273.3) inside the exponent of the saturation vapor pressure term; the Tetens form is exp(17.27 T / (T + 237.3)). The typo underestimated PET by roughly 15% at 20 C.

Usage

pet_hamon(doy, lat, tmean_c)

Arguments

doy

Day of year.

lat

Latitude (degrees).

tmean_c

Daily mean temperature (C).
